title: stelis purpurea
intro: Stelis purpurea, commonly known as Purple Stelis, is a species of orchid found in tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Stelis purpurea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stelis purpurea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
